other_conditions: Applicant must be a child of a construction worker.
Either parent of the applicant must be registered with the Madhya Pradesh Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board and hold a valid identity card for a continuous period of 5 years.
For postgraduate programmes, the applicant must have passed graduation with at least 60% marks in the first division or an equivalent grade.
For PhD programmes, the applicant must have passed a postgraduate degree with at least 60% marks and have 2 years of teaching, research or M.Phil experience in the relevant field.
Applicant must not be receiving benefits from any other source.
benefits_summary: Scholarship covering tuition up to $40,000 and a subsistence allowance up to $10,000 per year, plus travel expenses.
application_link: Shram Sewa Portal of Madhya Pradesh Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board
